title: SelfJudge — Can Small Language Models Judge Their Own Outputs?
blurb: Twenty-two small and mid-size models asked to grade their own answers. Where judging skill switches on, and why every model is lenient with itself.
description: A research report on whether small open-weight language models (1B to 70B) can act as their own quality and safety judge. Planted-anchor judging skill, self-assessment, self-leniency and a time perspective across model generations, March to October 2026.
data_provenance: selfjudge-results/*/metrics.json (July 2026 run + October 2026 extension run), copied by collect_data.py
